# ad-copy-agency-skill

> Open-source Claude Code skill (skill name: copy-masters) for AI ad copywriting. It runs an ad agency workflow with one agent per role: client brief, raw material collection, planner's creative brief, creative director's brief review ("creative surgery"), three creative teams writing in sequence, two CD review rounds with rework and defense, and a client review with fact and advertising-law checks. Output is a final headline, two alternates and a process check. It writes Korean copy for the Korean market (default) or English copy for the US market (`Copy language: en`), with a market-specific regulation checklist (US: FTC Act Section 5, 16 CFR 255 and 465).

Install: in a Claude Code session run `/plugin marketplace add 5hyuns/ad-copy-agency-skill` then `/plugin install copy-masters@ad-copy-agency-skill` (the skill is then `/copy-masters:copy-masters`); or `git clone https://github.com/5hyuns/ad-copy-agency-skill.git ~/.claude/skills/copy-masters` (then `/copy-masters`). Call it in Claude Code with subject, business goal, target, mode (performance or brand), channel (social feed, search ads, landing page, video script) and brand name. Requires Python 3.

Honest limit: in head-to-head tests against a single prompt given the same material, its final lines won 0.37 of the time on average. Its value is a traceable process and fact checking, not better copy. English was tested once on one product: picks won 0.39 against single prompts, a number that leans on one client pick (rerun nine times on the same shortlist, the client chose a line scoring 0.67).
